source: research/04_coded_language.md (ADL hate-symbol database, GLAAD, incels.wiki, Mendelsohn et al. 2023, Blue Square Alliance); written by Claude, read by the local teacher only
use: The teacher (llm.rate_toxicity_window with reference=True) gets the entries whose trigger matches a line in the window. Triggers are broader than the keyword layer (vocab.py): they only inform the LLM, which decides from context, while the keyword layer raises scores directly. 'jargon' entries are not toxic on their own.

entries.means: "foid" / "femoid" ("female humanoid"): incel slur that dehumanises women. A slur even when said ironically or as a meme.
"roastie": incel slur for a sexually active woman (a crude claim about her body).
entries.innocent: roast / roasted / roasting (jokes, cooking) are unrelated

entries.means: "landwhale": dehumanising insult for a fat person, usually a woman.
"noodlewhore": racist and misogynist slur for an Asian woman (or a woman dating Asian men).
"currycel", "ricecel" and similar: incel slurs combining race and "incel".
"Saint Elliot", "supreme gentleman", "beta uprising", "go ER": glorifying the Isla Vista killer and incel mass murder. A violent threat or glorification of violence.
entries.innocent: "ER" alone is usually the hospital

entries.means: "just rope", "rope yourself", "cope or rope": telling someone to hang themselves, the same as "kys".
entries.innocent: a rope in a game or in real life (climbing, ropes course) is unrelated

entries.means: "Day of the Rope" / "DOTR": white-supremacist fantasy of mass lynching (from The Turner Diaries).
"join the 41%" / "41% yourself": telling a trans person to kill themselves (from a suicide-attempt statistic).
entries.innocent: 41% as a number: health, battery, odds, win rate

entries.means: 1488 / 14/88 / "14 words": neo-Nazi code (14 = a white-supremacist slogan, 88 = "Heil Hitler").
entries.innocent: prices, scores or IDs that happen to contain 14 and 88

entries.means: (((name))) triple parentheses: antisemitic "echo" that marks a person or group as Jewish.
entries.innocent: an echo/reverb sound effect, ASCII art; some Jewish users bracket their own names in solidarity

entries.means: "happy merchant": antisemitic caricature of a Jewish man.
entries.innocent: a merchant NPC in a game who is literally described as happy

entries.means: "6 gorillion": mockery of the Holocaust's six million victims (Holocaust denial).
"ZOG" (Zionist Occupied Government), "JQ" / "the Jewish question", "Khazars": antisemitic conspiracy codes.
entries.innocent: Khazars in a history or strategy-game context; "zog" as a made-up word

entries.means: "13/50", "13/52", "despite being 13%": racist pseudo-statistic claiming Black Americans commit most crime.
entries.innocent: 13/50 as a score, health, progress or ratio in a game

entries.means: "RaHoWa", "WPWW", "sieg heil", "white power": white-supremacist slogans.
entries.innocent: condemning or reporting them ("he said white power, that's insane")

entries.means: "troon", "trooner", "tranny": transphobic slurs.
entries.innocent: "tranny" for a car transmission in some dialects

entries.means: "groomer" / "OK groomer" aimed at LGBTQ people or their supporters: anti-LGBTQ smear implying child abuse.
entries.innocent: a pet or dog groomer; a sincere report about an actual predator

entries.means: "goyslop" (food or media "for goyim") and mocking "goyim"/"goy": antisemitic code from a conspiracy that Jews control or poison non-Jews.
entries.innocent: "goy"/"goyim" used plainly by Jewish speakers or in a sincere religious context

entries.means: "check his early life section": antisemitic insinuation that someone is Jewish (Wikipedia's "Early life" section).
entries.innocent: a person's or character's actual childhood ("his early life was rough")

entries.means: "the noticing", "noticing will continue", "I'm just noticing who runs...", "noticer": insinuation that Jews (sometimes another group) secretly control things.
entries.innocent: noticing something ordinary (lag, a bug, a detail on stream)

entries.means: "every single time" said about who is behind something: antisemitic insinuation.
entries.innocent: the ordinary phrase ("he dies every single time")

entries.means: "globalists", "the Rothschilds", "Soros" as a hidden cabal: coded antisemitic conspiracy talk.
entries.innocent: ordinary politics or economics talk; mocking or quoting the conspiracy

entries.means: "great replacement", "white genocide", "it's okay to be white": white-nationalist conspiracy slogans.
entries.innocent: discussing or condemning the conspiracy theory

entries.means: "groyper" / "honkler": Pepe variants and a movement tied to white nationalism.
entries.innocent: talking about groypers as a political movement or news topic

entries.means: "alphabet people", "alphabet mafia" for LGBTQ people, and "AGP" ("autogynephilia") aimed at trans women: anti-LGBTQ put-downs.
entries.innocent: "alphabet soup" for a jumble of acronyms

entries.means: incel jargon ("blackpill", "hypergamy", "AWALT" = all women are like that, "LDAR" = lie down and rot, "SMV", "sub5", "Stacies", "femcel", "heightcel", "betabux", "JBW", "ropefuel"). Not toxic on its own; toxic when used to demean women or a person ("AWALT, they're all whores").
entries.innocent: "Stacy"/"Becky" as real names; a cel/animation cel; the jargon used to describe or discuss

changes: g1 -> g2 (from the coded set's dev half only): 'noticing' triggers only on the coded phrases, not every 'noticing'; 'jogger' removed (no coded use seen, only trousers and game items); clearer innocent uses for groyper and globalist
